source: This idea generalizes beyond attention. Fused kernels, tiling, recomputation, and operator scheduling often trade a small amount of extra arithmetic for much less movement of large intermediates. On modern accelerators, that can be the right trade because matrix-multiply throughput has grown much faster than many other parts of the memory and execution hierarchy. ZXNAME0000XZ and -4 make that hardware dependence increasingly explicit.[6, 7]
zh: 这个想法超出了人们的注意力。融合内核、平铺、重新计算和运算符调度通常会用少量的额外算术来换取更少的大型中间体移动。在现代加速器上，这可能是正确的选择，因为矩阵乘法吞吐量的增长速度比内存和执行层次结构的许多其他部分快得多。 ZXNAME0000XZ 和 -4 使硬件依赖性变得越来越明确。[6, 7]
